routes.speaker: Dan Paterson
routes.position: The Christian account supplies integrated relational and redemptive reasons why a perfectly loving God may permit temporary hiddenness.

bridges.statement: Evaluate divine presence and absence within the antecedent Christian story rather than abstract perfect-being theism alone.

Earthly demographics do not determine salvation because God may provide deathbed, implicit, counterfactual, or postmortem access.
Humble disclosure may protect freely formed love from distortion by overwhelming power, majesty, or benefits.
The cross and resurrection model how genuine felt silence can coexist with divine action and later redemptive defeat.
